newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ATHLETICS-IRELAND'S O'SULLIVAN MAY NOT DEFEND TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-IRELAND'S O'SULLIVAN MAY NOT DEFEND TITLE.

text.p: Ireland's Sonia O'Sullivan said on Tuesday she will probably run the 1,500 metres rather than defend her 5,000 metres title at the World athletics championships in Athens in August.
"I've already won the 5,000 metres title, so it's not really surprising that the 1,500 should now appeal to me," she said.
O'Sullivan, 27, said the only 5,000 metres race on her European programme for 1997 is at Oslo in the first week in July.
